# southvillerunningclub.co.uk — authoritative zone as held at Fasthosts
#
# Captured from the Fasthosts control panel, 8 August 2026.
# Every record below was independently verified against a live query to
# ns1.livedns.co.uk on the same day. Panel and live zone agree.
#
# THIS FILE IS THE ROLLBACK REFERENCE AND THE DIFF BASELINE.
# Do not edit it to reflect intended changes — capture reality, then diff.
#
# 18 records. Uniform TTL 3600 (Fasthosts exposes no TTL field).
# No CAA records. No DNSSEC. Registry delegation TTL 172800 (48h, Nominet).
#
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# MAIL — 11 of the 18. FASTHOSTS CONTINUES TO HANDLE ALL CLUB EMAIL.
# Copy exactly. Never proxy. Nothing about mail routing changes.
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
A       mail            213.171.216.40
A       mailserver      213.171.216.40
A       smtp            213.171.216.50
A       webmail         213.171.216.231
MX      @               mail.southvillerunningclub.co.uk        priority 0
TXT     @               "v=spf1 mx a include:_spf.livemail.co.uk ~all"
TXT     _dmarc          "v=DMARC1; p=none;"
CNAME   livemail1._domainkey    livemail1._domainkey.366995.dkim.livemail.co.uk
CNAME   livemail2._domainkey    livemail2._domainkey.366995.dkim.livemail.co.uk
CNAME   livemail3._domainkey    livemail3._domainkey.366995.dkim.livemail.co.uk
CNAME   livemail4._domainkey    livemail4._domainkey.366995.dkim.livemail.co.uk

# NOTE: MX points INSIDE this zone. mail.southvillerunningclub.co.uk resolves
# via the `mail` A record above, so that record is load-bearing for ALL
# inbound club mail. Drop or mistype it and mail stops with no obvious cause.
#
# NOTE: the DKIM CNAMEs carry a Fasthosts account number (366995). Losing them
# does not stop mail — it makes it fail authentication, and with DMARC at
# p=none that degrades quietly into spam folders rather than announcing itself.

# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
